auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: detail-page selected because WC Store API (/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products) returns 403 Cloudflare; restock detection requires Playwright per-product verification. Operator should confirm tradeoff.

auditNotes.perPageCeiling: ?per_page=500 honored on /shop/ (returned 500 unique products); ?per_page=600/750/1000 falls back to 24. perPage shipped as 24 because path-pagination template cannot structurally compose with sort+per_page query params on baseUrl (catalog-crawler.ts:121-125 strips trailing slash then concatenates template). Operator can bake sort+per_page into paginationPattern.template (e.g. '/page/{N}/?orderby=date&per_page=500') and accept page-1 default if a 20x request reduction is desired.
stageNotes: Stage 1: apex https://g4cgunstore.com returns 200; www variant returns 403; canonical tag <link rel='canonical' href='https://g4cgunstore.com/'> confirms apex
Stage 2: Cloudflare active (cf-ray + 8-batch evidence: bot/curl UA blocked, rapid burst 403, SQLi/XSS rules fire, honeypot paths blocked); CAPTCHA = reCAPTCHA v2 on /wp-login.php but NOT gating crawl
Stage 3: WooCommerce + Woodmart theme + WPBakery confirmed via generator meta + wp-content/plugins/woocommerce + product-grid-item classes; iPhone Safari UA bypasses CF challenge

Stage 4: WP REST product_cat (200, 100 cats) gives top-level structure; /shop/ adopted as single spine for 100% coverage (Rule C smallest URL set); per-category listing documented in topLevelCategories
Stage 4g extraction: 3 random products from /shop/?orderby=date page 1 all yielded title, url (200), price, stockStatus = in_stock
Stage 5: /shop/page/2/ returns 24 unique products with zero overlap to /shop/ page 1; ?page=2 query is silent NOOP (returns same 500 as page 1); path-style is the only working pattern

Stage 6: 3-outcome counter-control: default menu_order (230791,230797,233934) vs orderby=date (285841,285843,285744 -- descending IDs newest-first) vs orderby=price (30909,15187 -- totally different); sort honored
Stage 7: WP REST core /wp-json/wp/v2/product?modified_after= two-probe pass (future=0, past=5846); api-date-since-watermark selected
Stage 8: wp-rest-header on /wp-json/wp/v2/product header x-wp-total = 5846 (admin total; includes drafts; matches modified_after past-date probe). WC Store API CF-blocked, not viable for count probe

Stage 9: extractionTested=true; runtime path: hasWaf=true -> catalog-crawler uses Playwright for /shop/ walk; perPage=24 acceptable since watermark uses api-date-since-watermark (REST), full-sweep is rare
